children: Brunello Cucinelli's ability to outgrow the broader luxury sector has increased following the latest results, Citi's Alberto Cecchetto and Thomas Chauvet say. The Italian high-end fashion company was the fastest-growing European soft luxury company in the second quarter, with July trends reportedly continuing along a similarly positive trajectory, the analysts write in a research note. "Revenue outperformance is increasingly well established," they say. The analysts expect measured margin progression and stronger FCF conversion. The bank reiterates its buy recommendation on the stock. Shares are down 0.1%. (andrea.figueras@wsj.com)
